meta.source: MDA-MB-231 CRISPRi Perturb-seq (Woo & Sobti et al., bioRxiv 2026)
meta.caption: 7,474 MDA-MB-231 cells from a CRISPRi Perturb-seq screen: 16 chromatin organizers plus non-targeting controls, 37 guides collapsed to their target gene. Color by perturbation, target, or cell-cycle phase, and switch embeddings to morph between them. The legend shows each target's genome-wide transcript CV relative to a size-matched sample of non-targeting cells — size-matched because dispersion estimates scale with cell number. Knockdown of MIS18A (0.92x) and RNF8 (0.93x) lowers transcriptional variability; non-targeting cells split against themselves sit at 1.01x, which is what makes the rest readable. Processed from the raw count matrix with tools/process_crispri.py.
